sources.title: SRFI 1 filter-map and append-map combinators
sources.sections_read: Status, revision dates, rationale, and procedure index
sources.confirmed: The original SRFI records finalization on 1999-10-09, lists append-map and filter-map, and links its reference implementation. The retrieved page also records errata through 2026-10-03, so this live revision is treated as later evidence.
sources.limits: filter-map drops Scheme false values, so a result that must retain false needs separate filtering and mapping; evaluation order is unspecified, and multiple list arguments are traversed together. Cartesian expansion requires explicit nesting. The fetched specification contains later errata and the live implementation revision is undated. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C08.json.

sources.title: Common Lisp LOOP collect/append with conditional clauses
sources.version_or_date: Common Lisp the Language, second edition (1990)
sources.sections_read: Section 26.8 Value Accumulation, collect and append definitions and examples
sources.confirmed: collect accumulates an expression value during each iteration and returns the resulting list; examples use when or if to conditionally collect. append flattens list-valued results, while nconc destructively joins them.
sources.limits: Multiple for clauses can advance inputs together; dependent nested iteration needs nested loops or appended inner results. Keep destructive nconc behavior separate from ordinary new-list construction. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C08.json.

sources.title: Erlang list comprehensions and generator-variable scope
sources.version_or_date: Erlang/OTP 25 documentation; displayed guide version 13.2.2.16; OTP 25 release dated 2022-05-18
sources.sections_read: Sections 3.1 through 3.6: examples, nested generators, map/filter translations, and variable binding
sources.confirmed: The guide combines an output expression, generators, and filters into a list-valued expression and demonstrates Cartesian products. It also explains fresh generator variables and that bindings do not escape the comprehension.
sources.limits: Erlang pattern matching and variable binding differ from Python's, so their transfer needs explicit decisions. This run verified version-25 documentation and makes no claim about when the feature was first introduced. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C08.json.
